faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to sell, offer for sale or display in any place
               open to the public, whether for a fee or not, any obscene material.
(b)
As used in this section, the term "obscene material" shall include any film, picture,
               book, magazine, recording or other object which:
(1)
The average person, applying contemporary community standards, would find, taken as
               a whole, appeals to the prurient interest; and
(2)
Depicts or describes, in a patently offensive way, any ultimate sexual act, whether
               normal or perverted or actual or simulated, masturbation, excretory functions, sadomasochism
               or a lewd exhibition of the genitals; and
(3)
Taken as a whole, lacks serious literary, artistic, political or scientific value.
(Code 1960, § 17-11; Code 1981, § 21-24)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. §§ 18-7-101, 18-7-103.
